plugin.name: Reading aids
plugin.summary: Reading aids for the words: bold starts of words, wider spacing of letters, words and lines, and a calmer type for those who read with dyslexia.
plugin.author: Someone
plugin.description:
Bold starts of words lead the eye along a line. Wider spacing of letters, words and lines gives each word more room, and a calmer type keeps similar letters apart.

Each aid can be switched on alone, in the reader's menu, and set for each book.
